title: We spent $20,000 on meta ads and made $100,000 for this fashion brand...
description: We spent $20,000 on meta ads and made $100,000 for this fashion brand. Here’s what we changed to get them these results.  #metaadstips #facebookadvertisingtips #metaadsspecialist #facebookadstips #facebookcreative
transcript: We spent $20,000 to make $100,000 for this fashion brand and I'm gonna walk you through exactly what we did to achieve it. This fashion client really had a loyal customer base. They drove repeat purchases, but their new customer acquisition specifically through meta ads was losing them money. In addition, their products range from say 300 to 600 dollars AOV. So asking a new customer to commit to a purchase of that size as an unknown brand is very difficult. The brand had only ever ran campaign images or their e commerce content, nothing that showed the lifestyle or the everyday woman. As we know, fashion is an aspirational purchase and a consumer wants to see moments that represents their real life where the pieces are actually being worn. Likewise with styling content with a high price point, we started showcasing more versatility content, the top with multiple bottoms, the dress styled in very different ways. Seems logical, but this brand was just really tapping into that one pillar of campaign content and e commerce content. The Old Agency actually never ran explosions in their campaign, which made meta get really lazy. In our prospecting campaign, we really tightened up those exclusions to get meta focusing out of the warm or existing customers as they only ever had drops and not returning best sellers. We set this up as a multiple CBO campaign, different adsets per product categories, and we let meta try and find the winning products and also Winning creatives. If we did find winning creatives or winning products, we would separate them out into their own campaign and run it with budget to help them sell out. Their brand was always winning, but their ad strategy was just holding back their true growth. Not only did we achieve this within a few weeks, over the first six months working together, we actually doubled their new customer revenue.
